facts.fact: Decreto-Lei 43/2007 allows registry acts to be made in electronic form with an advanced electronic signature (art. 3), has the conservatórias' books kept electronically (art. 4) and lets any conservatória reach the registry databases regardless of territorial competence (art. 11); acts made on paper when the system is down are carried into it afterwards (art. 25), and paper rules still apply until the computerisation of the registry services is complete (art. 24). A legal provision covering civil, commercial, land and vehicle registration, not a report of practice.
facts.system: bases de dados dos registos (registo civil)

facts.fact: The decree-law places the civil registry database, with those of the commercial, land and vehicle registries, in the ownership of the Direcção-Geral dos Registos, Notariado e Identificação, whose Director-General is responsible for their processing (arts. 14 and 16); electronic signature rules are set by the minister responsible for justice (art. 3).

systems.system: bases de dados dos registos (registo civil)
systems.country_label: bases de dados dos registos; sistema informático
systems.owner: Direcção-Geral dos Registos, Notariado e Identificação (DGRNI)
systems.tiers: Conservatórias, each able to reach the databases regardless of territorial competence

systems.system: Digitalização dos assentos de registo civil
systems.country_label: assentos de registo civil digitalizados no âmbito da reforma em curso; extractação; digitalização dos registos
systems.owner: Direcção-Geral dos Registos, Notariado e Identificação (DGRNI)
systems.tiers: Digitised reproductions of civil registry entries are given the standing of the register books; a record still on paper is digitised when a registry act or certificate request touches it (arts. 5 and 27)

systems.country_label: certidão online de registo; certidão online
systems.owner: Direcção-Geral dos Registos, Notariado e Identificação; requests through the Casa do Cidadão
systems.tiers: Requested at any conservatória or competent public service, on the internet, or by the Casa do Cidadão telephone service after in-person authentication; delivered as an access code

systems.country_label: Porton di nôs Ilha; Portal da Casa do Cidadão
systems.owner: Casa do Cidadão; infrastructure maintained by NOSI
systems.tiers: National web portal for requesting documents, certificates and payments, hosted in the State data centre; registration in person at accredited counters

note: The decree-law does not name births or deaths and gives no count of offices; the capture is truncated in Portaria Conjunta 42/2007.
